title: 2017 Bowman Chrome Mason House Refractor San Diego Padres Baseball
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2017 Bowman Chrome trading card features Mason House of the San Diego Padres in a Chrome Refractor parallel. It's a great addition to any baseball card collection, especially for fans of the Major League (MLB). The card is from the 2017 season and is part of the Bowman set. 

The card is a sports trading card and is not autographed. The manufacturer is Bowman. It's a single card and is categorized under Trading Card Singles, Sports Trading Cards, and Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop. Get your hands on this unique card today!
